word: Word 16.114 compat 15: a justified Latin line squeezes its spaces by up to a quarter each (4.0 of 4.5 for 3 spaces, 8.5 of 9, 12.5 of 13.5 at 6pt spaces); compat 14 squeezes nothing
Between ideograph-only words the spaces squeeze about 2.5pt in total whatever their count, so spaces beside East Asian text are not squeezed per space
